title: Potent antitumor efficacy of anti-GD2 CAR T cells in H3-K27M+ diffuse midline gliomas
notes: Defines GD2 as a CAR-T target in pediatric CNS glioma; uses 14g2a-derived CAR; demonstrates preclinical efficacy in patient-derived H3K27M DMG models; foundational for translating GD2-CAR into pediatric brain tumors

title: GD2-CAR T cell therapy for H3K27M-mutated diffuse midline gliomas
notes: First-in-human GD2-CAR T cell trial in H3K27M DMG; 14g2a-based CAR; intravenous + intracerebroventricular delivery; clinical and radiographic responses; defines on-target CNS inflammation profile and intracranial dosing protocol

title: 4-1BB costimulation ameliorates T cell exhaustion induced by tonic signaling of chimeric antigen receptors
notes: Defines tonic signaling phenotype of 14g2a-derived CAR (GD2-28z) driven by scFv self-aggregation; 4-1BB co-stimulation rescues exhaustion vs CD28; canonical reference for choosing 4-1BB in GD2-CAR designs

title: c-Jun overexpression in CAR T cells induces exhaustion resistance
notes: Identifies AP-1 / c-Jun axis as molecular driver of CAR-T exhaustion; c-Jun overexpression rescues function of exhaustion-prone CARs including GD2-CARs; directly relevant exhaustion-mitigation strategy for 14g2a-based programs

title: CAR T cells administered in combination with lymphodepletion and PD-1 inhibition to patients with neuroblastoma
notes: Clinical GD2-CAR T cell + PD-1 inhibition trial in neuroblastoma; demonstrates feasibility of combining checkpoint blockade with GD2-CAR; limited efficacy as monotherapy at first-generation CAR doses; safety profile of GD2-CAR in pediatric patients

title: GD2 ganglioside in H3K27M and other pediatric high-grade gliomas — expression context
notes: GD2 expression on H3K27M DMG cells is robust and EZH2-regulated; expression in H3G34 DHG is not systematically reported and is a key empirical unknown for translation to that disease

title: Humanizing murine IgG3 anti-GD2 antibody m3F8 substantially improves antibody-dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity while preserving targeting in vivo
notes: Engineering origin of hu3F8 (naxitamab); CDR-graft humanization of murine 3F8; rationale for higher-affinity, reduced-immunogenicity scFv as a CAR-T binder candidate

title: Disialoganglioside GD2 on human neuroblastoma cells: target antigen for monoclonal antibody-mediated cytolysis and suppression of tumor growth
notes: Original 14.G2a (mouse IgG2a) anti-GD2 mAb; parent of ch14.18 / dinutuximab; canonical scFv source for most published GD2-CARs
